description: §38.10.3 — an `onclient:*` handler declared `server fn` in the file's top-level logic (outside the channel body) fires E-CHANNEL-006. The handler name is resolved to its declaration, whichever scope declares it.
rationale: §38.10.3: a function designated as the handler for an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL NOT be declared `server function`; the compiler SHALL emit E-CHANNEL-006 and reject the program.
